title: Cisco Warns of Attackers Exploiting Critical Authentication Bypass in SD-WAN Manager
summary: Attackers are exploiting a new critical zero-day flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, the system companies use to manage their Cisco SD-WAN networks, Cisco said in an advisory on September 30.
card_summary: Attackers are exploiting a new critical zero-day flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, the system companies use to manage their Cisco SD-WAN networks, Cisco said in an advisory on September 30.

sections.impact:
The flaw, CVE-2026-76504, could allow a remote attacker with no login access to use the Manager's API as the admin user.

Assessed severity: CRITICAL.
sections.mitigation: Fixed releases are available, and there is no workaround.
sections.context: This story is part of the recurring zero-day pattern where exploitation pressure is highest before broad patch adoption.
